sources.title: Independent scalar preference and quantity ambiguity derivation
sources.details: d=c-r; p=1/(1+exp(-d)); L=log(1+exp(-d)); dL/dd=-1/(1+exp(d))<0; common shift cancels. For unit price 1 yuan, shipping 2 yuan, quantity q=1 vs q=2 gives totals 3 vs 4 yuan, proving supplied inputs do not imply a unique total. 詳 own-inspection.md，數值由 math 與 CPU 交叉核。
